admin.setup.title: First-start setup
admin.setup.subtitle: Step {n} of {of}. Every answer is a normal setting you can change later in Settings
admin.setup.skipped: Setup skipped. Settings has every option
admin.setup.jobs_none: Pick at least one job, or this department stays as it is
admin.setup.supervisor: Supervisor grade (this grade and up supervise)
admin.setup.add_title: Police jobs with no department yet
admin.setup.add_text: Each one you tick becomes a department of its own. Pick its colours and a logo link here, or edit them in Departments later (a logo file is uploaded there)
admin.setup.add_logo: Logo link (a direct https:// image link, or leave empty for no logo)
admin.setup.no_jobs: Qbox gave no jobs: is qbx_core running?
admin.setup.desks_text: Untick a desk your city does not use (custom station MLOs may need a desk moved in Departments -> Desks)
admin.setup.storage_db: Data is saved in your MySQL/MariaDB database.
admin.setup.storage_files: Data is saved as files in the {folder} folder inside Crimson-Police. Keep and back up that folder.
admin.setup.storage_switch: oxmysql is running: to use the database instead, set Config.Database.enabled = true in config.lua and restart.
admin.setup.storage_copy: Where data is saved is chosen in config.lua only. To take data along when you switch, use {cmd}.
admin.setup.script_off: Turned off: the features that need it stay off
admin.setup.script_missing: None running for '{setting}': the features that need it stay off
admin.setup.preset_none_help: keep every setting as it is
admin.setup.step.departments_help: Which Qbox jobs belong to each department, and from which grade they supervise.
admin.setup.step.desks_help: The desks at the police stations that open the tablet.
admin.setup.step.scripts_help: The dispatch, ambulance, banking and police scripts found. 'auto' uses the first one running.
admin.setup.step.preset_help: A group of settings set in one go. You can apply another later in Settings -> Presets.
